items.title: W.T. "Ed" Kirkeby Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Well, I mentioned Durante, and Durante had baquet, so there's another case of a mixed band.

ctx.x: Yes, they were evolving. They were evolving. Don't forget the old stuff was kind of raw, and very few people could play it, you know? Certainly the New Yorkers. Yes. And I picked up a fellow by the name of Bill Moore, who was a mulatto, and really was the first Negro musician to play in a white band, a big white swing band. Benny Goodman claims that prestige, but it's not so.
The Rams beat it by ten years. Well, I mentioned Durante, and Durante had baquet, so there's another case of a mixed band.
I'm talking about a big swing band.
